headline: Week 13: Stroud Boys Bench 37 Points and Still Find a Way to Get Curb-Stomped
subhead: Hot Cocks dropped a 43-point bomb on Houston's finest while Jerry Jeudy — yes, THAT Jerry Jeudy — went nuclear for 40.5.
matchOfTheWeek: Jets' Juniors over Bo Nix Celli 159.72 to 154.62 in the closest fight that actually mattered. Celli got 35.2 from Brock Bowers, 26.1 from Caleb Williams, ran a 97.4% efficient lineup — basically played a perfect game — and still lost by 5. Wunder didn't win that game so much as Celli's roster ceiling did.
powerRankingsShakeup: Hot Cocks and MassiveCocks are both flexing 160+ and looking like the scariest cocks in the league heading into the stretch. Put an AR to My Head and Stroud Boys are in full freefall — Kyle scored 119, Jewett scored 116, and neither can blame anyone but themselves.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the war crime. Hot Cocks 159.74, Stroud Boys 116.28 — a 43-point execution that somehow UNDERSELLS how badly Jewett shit the bed. Stroud Boys left 36.80 on the bench. Their optimal lineup was 153. They had Jonnu Smith drop a 26-burger and STILL got blown out because Adam Thielen put up 23.90 in street clothes. That's not a lineup decision, that's a hate crime against your own roster.

Meanwhile in Cubby's house of horrors: OnlyFants 150, Put an AR to My Head 119, and the entire thing was powered by Jerry Jeudy going for FORTY POINTS. Jerry. Jeudy. In Cleveland. With Jameis Winston throwing him bombs. Kyle Dech got run over by a Browns receiver and now has to explain to his group chat that Pat Freiermuth scored 21.80 from his bench. Cubby's gonna act like he scouted this. He didn't. Nobody did.

The Good Ladds squeaked past T swift's Baddies 149-142, and Tnicolle is going to need a long shower because Jameis Winston put up 35.98 ON HER BENCH. That's the entire margin of the loss and then some. Mig won, but let's not pretend — Bryce Young scored 23.62 on his bench too. Both of these teams played fantasy football blindfolded and one of them just happened to trip into the end zone.

MassiveCocks edged The Olave Garden 161-153 in a genuine slugfest where Patrick got 27.30 from Terry McLaurin and still came up short. 226 Alpha snuck past LargestofRocks by 4.60 despite Russell Wilson dropping 27.86 from szara's bench — and LargestofRocks got 28.64 from Jayden Daniels AND 27.60 from Trey McBride and STILL LOST. That's the most painful 134 anyone's ever scored.

Bo Nix Celli ran a 97.4% efficient lineup and lost. Wunder ran his usual chaos and won. Football is not a meritocracy.

weeklyAwards.title: Bench Coach of the Year
weeklyAwards.blurb: Left 36.80 on the bench in a 43-point loss — mathematically you could've won and still lost, which is somehow worse.

weeklyAwards.title: The Jameis Special
weeklyAwards.blurb: Benched a 35.98-point quarterback and lost by 7.44 — Jameis threw for everyone except his own fantasy manager.

weeklyAwards.title: Cope Hardest Award
weeklyAwards.blurb: 97.4% lineup efficiency, Brock Bowers goes for 35, Caleb drops 26, and you still lost to Matt Wunder. Brutal.

weeklyAwards.title: Jerry F***ing Jeudy MVP
weeklyAwards.blurb: Cubby won by 30 because a Cleveland Brown caught 40 points of passes from Jameis Winston in the year of our lord 2024.
